name: the_address_of_the_struct_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define POOL_STRUCT 0x0c0385f0u /* the address of the queue's struct */
#define POOL_STRUCT 0x0c0385f4u /* the address of the queue's struct */

name: the_address_of_the_first_array_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define POOL_ARRAY1 0x0c0385f4u /* the address of the first array */
#define POOL_ARRAY1 0x0c0385f8u /* the address of the first array */

name: the_address_of_the_second_array_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define POOL_ARRAY2 0x0c0385f8u /* the address of the second array */
#define POOL_ARRAY2 0x0c0385f4u /* the address of the second array */

name: the_counter_is_not_at_the_structs_offset_six
subs: #define FIELD_COUNT 6u   /* the halfword: how many entries the queue holds */
#define FIELD_COUNT 8u   /* the halfword: how many entries the queue holds */

name: the_first_word_is_not_at_the_structs_offset_forty_four
subs: #define FIELD_A     44u  /* the word the first array carries */
#define FIELD_A     40u  /* the word the first array carries */

name: the_second_word_is_not_at_the_structs_offset_fifty_six
subs: #define FIELD_B     56u  /* the word the second array carries */
#define FIELD_B     64u  /* the word the second array carries */

name: the_pop_does_not_decrement_the_counter
subs: R(0) += 0xffffffffu;            /* the counter goes down by one */
R(0) += 0x00000000u;            /* the counter goes down by one */

name: the_pop_does_not_write_the_counter_back
subs:
vf3_mem_set_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_A, R(3));
    vf3_mem_set_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT, (uint16_t)R(0));

name: the_counter_is_not_stored_as_a_halfword
subs:
vf3_mem_set_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT, (uint16_t)R(0));

    R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY1);

vf3_mem_set_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT, R(0));

    R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY1);

name: the_reset_does_not_read_the_first_array
subs:
R(5) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY1);
    R(5) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(5));

name: the_reset_does_not_read_the_second_array
subs:
R(5) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY2);
    R(5) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(5));

name: the_push_reads_the_structs_duplicate_instead_of_its_first_word
subs:
R(2) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_A);
    R(6) = R(5);

R(2) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_A2);
    R(6) = R(5);

name: the_push_reads_the_structs_second_duplicate_instead_of_its_second_word
subs:
R(2) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_B);
    R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY2);

R(2) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(4) + FIELD_B2);
    R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY2);

name: the_pop_reads_the_first_array_from_the_second_array
subs:
R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY1);
    R(3) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(0) + R(5));

R(0) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_ARRAY2);
    R(3) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, R(0) + R(5));

name: the_pop_does_not_copy_the_counter_into_r1
subs:
R(0) = half(vf3_mem_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT));
    R(1) = R(0);

R(0) = half(vf3_mem_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT));
    R(1) = R(0) + 1u;

name: the_pop_does_not_use_the_structs_address
subs:
R(4) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_STRUCT);
    R(0) = half(vf3_mem_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT));

R(4) = vf3_mem_u32(ram, POOL_STRUCT) + 4u;
    R(0) = half(vf3_mem_u16(ram, R(4) + FIELD_COUNT));

name: the_push_does_not_return_to_the_caller_when_it_refuses
subs:
R(0) = R(6);                 /* the delay slot of the `rts` */
        s->pc = R(16);

R(0) = R(6);                 /* the delay slot of the `rts` */
        s->pc = 0u;

name: the_pop_does_not_return_to_the_caller
subs:
R(0) = R(5);                     /* the delay slot of the `rts` */
    s->pc = R(16);

R(0) = R(5);                     /* the delay slot of the `rts` */
    s->pc = 0u;
